purpose: Predeclared bounded direct3D DIEGEO158 geometry/plane-finalization research. Candidate format recognition is constrained by exact3-int header conversions. All connectivity indices are positive and within retained actual vertex counts, including partial coordinate case. No partial connectivity or alternate geometry formats.

cases.hypothesis: Valid direct3D triangle; header3conversion selects direct branch, finalizer creates one plane.
Coplanar equal-orientation faces share first plane; stable traversal/order.
Zero requested counts preserve actual4vertices/2faces; importer loops over stored extents and still consumes all rows.
Negative requested counts are no-op resizes; reuse old valid extents and supply complete rows.
Three-conversion format0 enters direct branch but omits face-row reads, preserving valid old connectivity.
Opposite unit normals have squared difference4 and form distinct plane records.
Positive fourth face integer skips classification; new allocation startszero.
Collinear triangle has zero normalized normal; classification remainszero, plane listempty.
Tiny nonzero-area triangle normalizes before1e-6 test; should not be rejected merely for small raw area.
Parallel displaced triangles create separate planes using bbox diagonal scale over all6points.
Blank header reportserror without vector replacement; preexisting valid geometry finalizes again.
EOF header preserves valid existing geometry; flags/classifications compared around finalizer.
